parameters.question: Compare WGCNA module-trait correlation tables (module eigengene Pearson correlation with Disease and p-value). Module color labels, row order, column order and headers may differ. If the same number of modules is found, match modules by correlation profile and require Correlation and Pvalue within +/-0.05. If module counts differ, the Spearman rank correlation of ranked absolute correlations (top-N, N = min module count) must be >= 0.6 and the sign of the module with the highest |correlation| must match the reference.
